newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Unicef approves $80 mln assistance for Nigeria.
newsitem.headline: Unicef approves $80 mln assistance for Nigeria.

text.p: A financial aid package worth $80 million has been approved for Nigeria for the next five years by the United Nations Children's Fund (UNICEF), its local representative said on Tuesday.
The money was the biggest single aid package to an African country, country representative Ibrahim Fall told a seminar in the Nigerian capital Abuja.
"The agreement for this financial package was reached in January this year between the government and UNICEF," he said.
He said $65 million of the amount would come from UNICEF's coffers while the rest would be raised from local and external sources.
The funding will go towards addressing the desperate needs of women and children identified by the agency in Nigeria.

"It includes interventions in the areas of health, nutrition, education, water and environmental sanitation," said Fall, adding that "the peculiar situation of street children will also be addressed."
